codex.ssc-primalstinct.instincts.desc: This form is governed by the Primalstinct system: instinct grows over time and through behavior, crossing thresholds raises its level, and it locks at max value.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.instincts.level.0: L0: Instinct awakened - the most restricted base state.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.instincts.level.5: L5: Maxed and locked - instinct changes halt while gained abilities remain; recovery items can lower and unlock it.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.instincts.open_hi: Use the button below to read about your current instinct stage and abilities.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.title: Primalstinct
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.back: Return to the Book of Shape Shifter
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.instincts.fa: Your current instinct stage is L%s. Instinct changes over time and through actions, advancing when it crosses a threshold.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.abilities.fa: You are at stage L%s. This form has no dedicated ability description for this stage yet.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.level.1.inst:
Instinct awakens. You are adjusting to this body, and its first impulses are beginning to shape your actions.

Instinct changes over time and through actions. Crossing a threshold changes your stage.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.level.2.inst:
Your wild instincts emerge. Your body's impulses grow clearer and begin to change how you interact with the world.

Instinct continues to change over time and through actions.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.level.3.inst:
Instinct intensifies. Wild impulses become increasingly familiar, and acting on them feels more natural.

Instinct continues to change over time and through actions.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.level.4.inst:
Instinct approaches its limit. Your impulses are strong, and you are nearing the final stage.

Reaching maximum instinct locks it.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.level.5.inst:
Instinct reaches its peak. Under the default rules, maximum instinct locks ordinary increases and reductions while retaining your abilities.

External recovery that lowers instinct below its maximum releases the lock.

ssc-primalstinct.endgame.info.primal_oce:
[Primal Avatar]
"...So it is you. The child I have waited for."
The ancient shade bends down and touches its forehead to yours. Warmth floods down your spine into your limbs.

You remain a one-slot beast, but the sealed pack reopens and the words no longer twist. The instinct remains - yet now you walk beside it.
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.pedestal.accept: The pedestal accepts your offering - ancient energy stirs along the conduit.
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.pedestal.reject: The pedestal stays silent - only a hunter at the peak of instinct may offer.
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.portal.not_read: The world beyond still sleeps... (avatar dimension unavailable)
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.portal.entered: You pass through the primal gate into ancient silence. Crouch upon the Conversion Platform to complete the final metamorphosis.
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.portal.returned: You return along your own path to the familiar world.
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.portal.return_f: The memory of your path has faded; you are guided back to the world's origin.
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.portal.dismount: Dismount before stepping into the primal gate.
ssc-primalstinct.endgame.portal.fell: The edge of the void pushes you back to the sanctum.
